Rug ticks on the walls of the panel box

Source: R/layers-rug.R
geom_rug_3d.Rd

Marks the values of one position on a pane of the panel box with short ticks, the three-dimensional counterpart of ggplot2::geom_rug().

Usage

geom_rug_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  sides = c("floor:x", "floor:y"),
  length = 0.03,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard layer arguments.

sides

Character vector of "pane:axis" entries. The pane is "floor", "back" or a pane name as in position_project_3d(); the axis is the position whose values are marked. "floor:x" ticks the x values on the floor, "back:z" the z values on the back walls. An optional third part names the pane edge the ticks start from, such as "floor:x:ymax".

length

Tick length as a fraction of the pane's extent.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Details

Ticks lie in the pane, perpendicular to the marked axis. Without an edge they start at the pane edge on the camera side, where the axis labels usually sit. Like position_project_3d(), ticks are painted with their pane, and an axis the layer does not map draws no ticks.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(80), y = rnorm(80), z = rnorm(80))
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) +
  geom_point_3d() +
  geom_rug_3d(sides = c("floor:x", "floor:y", "back:z"), alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_3d()
